planning_capabilities.mapping_interpretation: Mapping is an evidence-based starting point for classifying work type and locating existing code seams. It is not a numerical effort estimate, a work completion percentage, or proof that unmapped code does not exist outside the pinned inventory.

trace_patterns.pattern: source requirement → candidate → atomic obligation → graph work
trace_patterns.method: Use source_inventory/atomic obligations/execution_trace identifiers, then match candidate/work refs in mapping; preserve many-to-many.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Filter PACKAGE membership and contains edges; example PACKAGE:C12A.

trace_patterns.method: Join atomic-obligation-dispositions and execution-trace; report test definition separately from execution status.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Use contains edges and parent_id/Task IDs; example TASK:CORE:C12A:004 and its .Sxx children.

trace_patterns.method: Follow contains edges and package_id/parent identifiers; verify tree IDs against task graph.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Follow maps_to_code and mapping.current_code_node_refs; example TASK:CORE:C05B:003.

trace_patterns.method: Use mapping rows current_code_node_refs and maps_to_code edges; no refs does not prove global absence.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Join atomic-obligation-dispositions requirement_ids for package/task; example AO:WL-TR-054-02:01.

trace_patterns.method: Use explicit candidate/atomic obligation IDs and mapping references; do not treat shared IDs as exclusive ownership.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Use ac_test_ids in disposition ledger; example AC:CORE:C08:007.

trace_patterns.method: Read open_decision_id, decision_reference, affected_scope and BLOCKED_BY_DECISION edges.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Compare planned test refs against execution_trace.product_test_execution_status; example TEST:C12A:011 remains NOT_EXECUTED in cited trace.

trace_patterns.method: Use source_refs/locator on OPEN_DECISION record; locator denotes evidence, not approval.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Filter explicit HARD_ORDER/depends_on and preserve source/target direction; example REL-STAGE4-010.

trace_patterns.method: Select HARD_ORDER/depends_on and normalize source-dependent-on-target to target-before-source.

trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Join decision_refs and OPEN_DECISION edges; example OPEN:C04:ADVISER-MEASURE.

trace_patterns.method: CONTRACT_ORDER is scoped interface readiness; unknown threshold stays unknown.
trace_patterns.retrieval_example_and_steps: Read affected_scope on matching open decision records; do not broaden beyond affected_packages/tasks.

trace_patterns.method: Inspect community_profiles; membership is a navigation aid, never a delivery boundary.

trace_patterns.method: Join test refs with execution_trace and statuses; NOT_EXECUTED remains not executed.
